messages.subject: methylKit 0.5.5 is released
parts:
methylKit 0.5.5
--------------

IMPROVEMENTS AND BUG FIXES

* Differential methylation percentage calculation bug fixed. The bug
occurred when "min.per.group" argument used in unite() function and
when "weighted.mean=TRUE" in calculateDiffMeth() function.

* plotTargetAnnotation() bug is fixed. Bug occured when "precedence"
argument set to FALSE.
